query:
SELECT category, season, leagueId, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM matches WHERE category = 'world_cup' GROUP BY category, season, leagueId;
SELECT category, leagueId, season, kickoffUtcMs, homeTeam, awayTeam FROM matches WHERE category = 'world_cup' ORDER BY kickoffUtcMs ASC LIMIT 5;
